status: proposed reproducible motion logic, anchored to observed film states; not recovered original animation

rules.master_clock: absolute seconds; frame/fps; one camera authority
rules.camera: C2-continuous position spline, quaternion orientation, smooth FOV; world-anchored portals; no DOM resize teleport
rules.text: glyph stagger 2 frames; 12-frame opacity/lift entry; 66-frame min readable hold; 10-frame exit; clamp glyph progress to [0,1]
rules.glyph_formula: p=clamp((frame-inFrame-glyphIndex*2)/12,0,1); opacity=p*p*(3-2*p); offsetY=(1-opacity)*8 CSS px; retain final layout metrics
rules.panel: 420ms translateY 12px -> 0 and opacity 0 -> 1; focus remains inside visible panel
rules.voice: audio level smoothed attack 80ms, release 240ms; rings scale 1+0.04*level; do not randomize speaking state
rules.media: sourceTime=inPoint+(t-componentIn); deterministic decode for exports; no hard crop changes
rules.reduced_motion: hold camera and replace travel with short opacity handoffs; keep all controls operable
